items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Didn't you say that Bunk Johnson knew Dr. Nelson? [INTERVIEWEE] I'm sure he did. He used to talk about it.

ctx.x: They're going to take up music? No, no, no. It's me and my brother and my daddy, he's played piano too in organ. He used to play organ at the church in his spare time. Every sudden we'd go to church. He played organ and piano. He's not a fancy piano player but he played it. When he was out in the country he was a pretty good doctor. You had to use it on your own. See, the poor people are 80 miles from here. Just like this doctor come in here and rush to get the ambulance. No hospital out there. No, dirt roads,…
Didn't you say that Bunk Johnson knew Dr. Nelson?
I'm sure he did. He used to talk about it.
